model_outputs.frame_ref: index into request frames, transforms and conventions
model_outputs.time_s: H strictly increasing times relative to request reference time
model_outputs.position_m: [E,H,3] absolute EEF targets in the declared frame
model_outputs.orientation: [E,H,…] valid rotations; representation and ordering fixed by schema
model_outputs.valid_mask: typed field and timestep validity; invalid fields are not zero-valued targets

request_contract: robot/task/TCP frame definitions and timestamps; camera extrinsics optional
explicit orientation constraints for position-only tasks
horizon length / padding and time convention
sys0_contract: accept / reject requested frame and capability
track and locally refine EEF targets at control rate
return actual EEF states and outcome with matching plan version
required_data: orientation and time labels or explicit constraints
aligned multimodal history and actual executed EEF states
required_evaluation: metric 3D position and rotation error with multiple-valid-solution handling
legacy_exclusion: Existing 2D analytic benchmark, v3 path2d config and projection demo are diagnostic archives, not this contract.

runtime_sensors.camera_calibration: optional G1/G2; not required by G0

full_output_additions.modes: select one entire path, never per-coordinate average

frame_note: Body/TCP output frame remains defined even when camera intrinsics/extrinsics are not supplied to Sys1.

minimal_research_schema.position: absolute xyz metres, normalized using training/predefined domain only
minimal_research_schema.gripper: physical width or explicit open/close event
minimal_research_schema.schema: eef_topdown_v1; proposed, not the synthetic prototype schema
minimal_research_schema.status: design only; distinct from implemented eef-smoke-1
